_byline: Claude Code · Opus 5.5 · 2026-10-02 — Kasm Workspaces 'Devbox' workspace (P-1 step 3). Field names follow the Kasm admin UI (Workspaces > Add Workspace); README.md says how they are entered.
description: The owner's persistent Ubuntu XFCE devbox: Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, the full toolchain, Synaptic. Home on /data/probata/volumes/devbox/home.
_sizing_note: Owner 2026-10-02 01:27: start at 2 CPU / 4 GB. ovh-files has 8 cores / 22 GB with swap fully used.
_persistent_profile_note: Not a Kasm persistent profile: Kasm 1.19 requires {username} or {user_id} in that path, and this desktop's home already lives at the fixed host path the Coolify devbox and the reserved claude listener use. The home is therefore a plain volume mapping onto /home/kasm-user (below), the same bind deploy/devbox.yaml makes.
_volume_notes: Kasm volume mappings take no mount-propagation option, so /mnt/desktop-share is a plain bind here, not rslave as in deploy/devbox.yaml: an SMB automount that appears after the session starts is not seen until the next session.
The devbox's Authentik machine identity file stays with the Coolify devbox container only: Kasm volume mappings are directories, and the always-on Coolify service is where machine clients run.
